notes: Inbound from indie dev duo building a niche code-collab chat + assistant for small OSS projects. Signed up via signup flow 2026-03-10; used free credits. No AE outreach yet. Devs are very cost-sensitive — "cheap tokens" is repeated on forms. Wants hosted API for speed to market. Asked on chat widget: 'can we run on hosted for now and move to private later?' Wants simple SDK examples and menu for model choices. Reported first week usage = 12k tokens (JS SDK). Raised rate-limit via support form 2026-03-12. Interested in quantized model suggestions but not ready for Dedicated. Security: wants audit logs; will revisit SSO only if we scale. Quotes from founder: 'we need 150-300ms p95 for interactive sessions or users churn'. Typical indie style notes: shorthand, quick returns, pragmatic about cost.
timeline: 2026-03-10 - self-serve signup, created account, free credits applied
2026-03-11 - integrated JS SDK, first 50 API calls, ~12k tokens used
2026-03-12 - submitted rate-limit increase form (support request), asked about p95 latency
2026-03-12 - sent short feedback via contact form asking about model price/quality trade-offs
technical_requirements: p95 latency target 150-300ms for chat; throughput low (5-10 req/s); embeddings for semantic doc search (daily batch update); prefer open models / low-cost variants; simple fallback to smaller model if cost spikes
